caption: The drawing features a central figure with black, curly hair and a long, flowing robe shaded in brown and tan tones, kneeling or sitting amidst various symbolic objects. The figure holds a tall, narrow structure resembling a church tower with a clock face, arched doorway, and a pointed roof topped by a flag, in the right hand. In the left hand, the figure holds the stem of a large goblet or chalice, which contains a circle with a cross inside it. In the upper left corner, there is a stylized winged figure and a hand, surrounded by a curved border. Decorative floral patterns with outlines in off-white appear in the bottom corners of the drawing. The overall color palette consists mainly of browns, tans, greys, and black, with garland-like or radiating lines accentuating certain objects, such as the circle around the cross. The background is a washed tan color with undulating, irregular edges. At the bottom left corner of the bordered area, the numbers "30" and the letter "A" are inscribed, while the number "41" appears in the lower margin outside the drawing.
title: Plate 41: Saint Barbara: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
